title: Add JSON Schema Request Validation Middleware
description: Introduces a zero‑dependency middleware that validates incoming request bodies, query strings, and params against user‑provided JSON Schemas. This reduces boilerplate validation code, catches malformed input early, and improves overall API robustness.
testCases: Valid request passes when body matches schema
Invalid request returns 400 with detailed error messages
Validation works for query parameters and URL params
Middleware skips validation when no schema is provided
acceptance: All new tests pass, existing test suite remains green, validation middleware can be attached to a route via app.use('/users', validate({body: userSchema}), handler) and returns 400 on schema violations with a JSON error payload.
reason: Provides a production‑ready, reusable way to enforce input contracts without external dependencies, addressing a common pain point for developers and preventing runtime errors caused by bad client data.
